method: Read the final test diff and complete CreditNudge, ExtensionControls, useResource and useWorkflow; traced Api beginMutation persistent intent/error mapping and native AccountTools nudge preview/confirmation/unknown handling. Cross-checked the actual CI4 Linux failed DOM and exact failing assertion. No source changes or test reruns by this reviewer. Author targeted report was read; prior passing baseline and final targeted pass do not reproduce hosted timing.

testReadinessFinding.original: findByRole waited for a send button rendered even while the preview was pending; checkbox snapshots empty preview hash if clicked then, so disabled button correctly dispatches nothing.
testReadinessFinding.boundary: Static execution-order defect identified; original CI exact timing was not instrumented or locally reproduced.

preservedAndStrengthenedAssertions: Explicit controlled pending preview verifies checkbox cannot bind empty hash and disabled send dispatches nothing.
Resolving the exact preview through act flushes React before assertions; checkbox remains unchecked and send remains disabled until new user confirmation.
Reason change clears confirmation; subsequent explicit confirmation enables one send and duplicate click does not create another send.
Cooldown message still distinguishes no new email from confirmed sent.

Uncertain delivery still yields a recovery action, one nonempty original operation identity, no read before recovery click, exactly one send, only reads of original identity, and positive sent result.
Production keeps durable pre-dispatch intent, unknown receipt and no automatic resend; test does not mock away that chain.
notWeakened: No assertion removed for once-only delivery, reason-specific params or cooldown.
No timeout increase, sleep, retry, skip, product-source change, or falsely accepted unknown result.
